restrictions: Messages are exactly 64 bytes (one root block, flags 11, length 64, counter 0).
Grouped birthday: 2^96 groups; shared m0..m14; enumerate all m15 in 0..2^32-1.
K_full is the full 256-bit partial-eval digest. Sparse set indexes by top 140 bits and stores K_full.
Every message is charged 8 Word ops of full-K compare budget (worst-case envelope). Compressions are NOT used for unequal-K index hits.
Equal K_full: two reference compressions; halt on success; at most V_max=8 verification attempts per run.
Candidate ops/msg = 295 = 252 (inner, FF xor-only) + 14 pack + 21 table + 8 compare. Plus T_ver<=16. No expectations in the time inequality.
Repair of 4dd74401 fatal F-COST-INDEX-COMPARE-TAIL (and retains c145 F-COST-VERIFY-OMITTED repair). Doomed 127.417 path without worst-case compare is not resubmitted.
Success 0.39 under H1-grouped-digests only; time bound is heuristic-free worst-case.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256; 2 rounds; classical 256-bit word RAM.

heuristics.statement: For uniformly random independent group prefixes and exhaustive m15 enumeration, the 2^128 digests behave like independent uniform 256-bit strings for bounding F1, F2, and F4 (V_max exhaustion), up to a negligible additive gap covered by the allowance between the model bound (>0.3932) and claimed success probability 0.39.
heuristics.scope: Success-probability claim only for this algorithm with V_max=8 and 140-bit indexing. Does not support replacing worst-case compare charges by expectations in the time bound.
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer matched-scale digest-xor-mask experiments at widths 16, 20, and 24 with N_t^2/2^w=1, plus single-group stress, extrapolated to full 256-bit collision statistics under H1.
heuristics.limitations: H1 unproved. Time bound does not rely on H1. Truncation cannot detect almost-permutations. No full-scale collision known.
